notes.title: Update 0.1.5.5 (Happy new year everyone!)
notes.content:

added maps:

Pirate Island
Lost Island
Seafaring

Quality low/good/best
Weather rain/snow/foggy/thunder/sunny
Day and night cycle
Motion blur
Bloom
Depth of field
Language support Eng/Ger
All players must be near each other to start mapchange, if they're not, everyone will get a message on screen.
Added new tasks "speak with" and "use".


Regards,

Laru

notes.title: Version 0.1.4.9 is out
notes.content:
Hi there!

Version 0.1.4.9 has just been released. This update took a bit more time, because we were dealing with various problems that could not be so easily solved.

Following changes we have made:
- missing colliders of objects
- correcting colliders of trees
- hovering items
- talking NPCs
- pathfinding was recalculated
- mouse pointer on/off with F2
- fps indication with F1
- better mana and health calculation
- stamina consumption and regeneration fixed
- map change loading time reduced
- performance improvement
- falling damage fixed
- close button in the shops
- can´t walk with an open shop window
- version indication
- quest items are no longer sellable
- 3 difficulty levels
- player will no longer die when running downhill
- 2 new NPCs added
- quest reset button added in help screen
- quest rewards added

To reset the quests start the game and enter the lobby. Hit ESC and click "help". Now the reset button is below. The reset button is only accessable in the lobby.

A little problem which we will solve in the next update is:
When you have finished a quest and the NPC has another one for you, it takes a little time (2 - 3 sec.) till you can see it.

notes.title: New update is coming with bugfixes
notes.content:
Hello at all! The next update contains bugfixes for following problems:
- missing/correction of colliders (trees and buildings)
- falling damage problem
- hovering items
- too much npcs are talking
- pathfinding (recalculating navigation map)
- mouse pointer (on/off)
- fps
- sound volume of the background music

We will change the the controls. Then it´s possible to attack the enemies directly and you do not need to wait until the character changed to battle stance.

If you find further bugs please tell us about it.

[b]Update[/b]
We have worked through the weekend, but unfortunately we have some problems with healing / mana / stamina calculation. Therefore, the next update comes with some delay. 

Thank you for your understanding.
